about: Project Scout eval: each project description has papers in the library that clearly serve it. A good Scout run lists at least one of them in its top 10, ideally as a strong match.

cases.description: An app that turns scanned PDFs, photos, voice memos and screen recordings into one structured JSON format, with where and when each item appears.
A browser game where players explore an endless 3D world generated in real time from their moves, and places they come back to must look the same as before.
A tool that turns a text prompt into a playable game, with an AI player that tests the game and finds bugs to fix.
An avatar creator for indie games: upload one drawing of a stylized character and get hair geometry that is ready to animate in a game engine.
Generate many realistic professional work tasks, like reports and spreadsheets, with expert demonstrations to train an office automation agent.
Speed up a diffusion-based vision-language model that answers questions about images, by skipping the image when it isn't needed at a step.
An open-weights voice assistant that understands spoken requests, reasons over the conversation and calls tools like calendar and search, all in one model.
Train a robot arm controller that writes code as its policy, using fine-tuning and then reinforcement learning, like coding agents are trained.
Clean my instruction fine-tuning dataset by finding the examples that quietly make the model less safe, even though none of them look harmful.
An agent that controls a desktop computer with mouse and keyboard to finish long office workflows, and recovers when it clicks the wrong thing.
Real-time streaming video generation for a live talking avatar, with no lag and a consistent look over many minutes.
One embedding model for search across text, images, audio and video, so a single query can find any kind of file.
Collect high-quality training trajectories for an AI coding agent that fixes issues in real GitHub repositories.
Evaluate coding agents on features that need coordinated changes across several repositories at once, like a frontend and its backend.
Automatically crop photos and choose the best framing from 360 degree panoramas, and explain the photography rule behind each choice.
Distill a large math reasoning model into a small student model without having to tune the sampling temperature of the teacher.
Faster attention kernels for training long-context transformers in low precision (FP8 or FP4) on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.
Make a reasoning model stop thinking once it has enough information, to cut tokens and cost on math and coding questions.
Product image search where the shopper gives a reference photo plus a text change, like the same shoe but in red.
Use a language model agent instead of a human to teleoperate a robot and collect demonstration data cheaply.
Generate captions for long videos that focus on the important events instead of small background details.
A model that watches a live video stream and has to decide at each moment whether to answer the user or keep watching, trained with reinforcement learning.
A robot policy that goes straight from camera pixels to actions without a separate frozen vision encoder in front of the language model.
An AI agent that carries out physics research from the question to the final result, and a benchmark to test whether it can.
Generate videos that show a chosen emotion and fine-tune the generator with reinforcement learning using a reward model for emotion.
Make the network of a large AI training cluster faster by predicting traffic and reconfiguring optical switches ahead of time.
